missing: A direct, priced pick: for a propane absorption fridge (run it on gas, power only controls/lights/phones) versus a 12V compressor fridge, which specific power station or LiFePO4 battery plus solar panel gets a couple through two nights, with current prices and how to connect it to the RV.
why: No major reviewer or authority appears with testing; the only authority (Newmar manual) is unreadable. The results are calculators, sizing essays, two brand blogs, one retailer answer and niche affiliate guides, and none combines the absorption-vs-compressor fork with a tested, priced weekend kit for an RV. A focused page with a fridge-type decision, a Wh budget for fridge+lights+phones, and current-priced picks would stand out.
